notes: Now genuinely replaces your Mac wallpaper: the lock screen, the menu bar and the moment before the app starts show a still of it too. It also opens at login by default, re-registers itself after updates, and puts its windows back if macOS drops them, so you never have to pick a wallpaper twice. Turn "Use it as the Mac's own wallpaper too" off in Settings to get your old wallpaper back.
